business_summary: Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides private educational services in Hong Kong. The company operates through Provision of Private Educational Services, Investments in Securities, Money Lending, and VR and Digital Entertainment segments. The company offers primary and secondary tutoring services, skill courses, test preparation courses, providing loans as a money lender, and trading of securities, English language training and international test preparation courses, and dance tuition services, as well as STEAM education services. It also trades in virtual reality and gaming products. It provides private education services under the Modern Education, Modern Bachelor Education, and Modern English brand names. The company was formerly known as Hong Kong Education (Int'l) Investments Limited and changed its name to Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited in January 2023. Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited는 홍콩에서 사립 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 사립 교육 서비스 제공, 증권 투자, 자금 대출, VR 및 디지털 엔터테인먼트 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 초등 및 중등 개인교습 서비스, 기술 강좌, 시험 준비 강좌, 대금업자로서의 대출 제공, 유가증권 거래, 영어 교육 및 국제 시험 준비 강좌, 댄스 강습 서비스, STEAM 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 가상 현실과 게임 제품도 거래합니다. Modern Education, Modern Bachelor Education 및 Modern English 브랜드 이름으로 사교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Hong Kong Education (Int'l) Investments Limited로 알려졌으며 2023년 1월에 Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited는 1997년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 애드미럴티에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
